hanrahan-coleson.note: Best friends with Jack Turowsky of UMass Lacrosse. They played lax together in high school at Berkshire and train together in off-season. Both players wear #2.
"You don't put a muzzle on a pit bull." - Greg Carvel when asked if an after-the-whistle roughing call on Hanrahan frustrated him.

kerr-justin.note: Nearly quit hockey after not landing with a USHL or NAHL team late in his high school career. Played AAA instead, leading to one year of NAHL and one year of USHL play.
Was initially a Bowling Green commit

nestrasil-vaclav.note: Highest-drafted forward in UMass history at 25th OVR

oneill-cameron.note: Both brothers played in Hockey East with Providence and UMass Lowell. Sister played lacrosse at Penn State and coached at PSU and Towson. One brother is now a secret service agent.
